product.name: Sky Garden Firebreak Riverstone Border
product.description:
Sky Garden's riverstones are ideal for the perimeter of any green roof. These stones facilitate efficient drainage, ensuring water flows freely off the roof, while giving the system a clean, crisp finish. Enhanced drainage around green roof perimeters prevents waterlogging, promoting healthy plant growth and structural integrity.
Their naturally rounded and washed composition, with diameters ranging from 20 to 40mm, ensures a pleasing, natural look. Whilst also acting as an effective barrier, helping to restrict the spread of plant material to drainage and gutter outlets.
Features & Benefits: Sky Garden Firebreak Riverstone BorderEnsures efficient water drainageEnhancing the overall visual attractiveness of green roofsPerfect for the perimeter of any green roof asthetically and functionally
Crafted from natural riverstone, the stones come in a variety of colors, from browns to greys, offering a visually appealing and functional addition to your green roof system. This natural composition ensures durability and long-lasting performance, making it a perfect choice for green roof perimeters.

product.name: Wallbarn Universal Extra Adjustable Pedestal for Decking and Paving
product.description: Wallbarn's Universal  Extra adjustable pedestal range is suitable for both paving and decking. They are particularly ideal for porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiums. Even flat roofs are built to a small fall to allow adequate drainage. The adjustable pedestals have a telescopic stem which allow you to make millimetre-precise manual adjustments in height in order to achieve a flat upper surface. Universal Extra pedestals are a freestanding system, so no fixings are made through the membrane underneath, ideal for warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systems. They also come with an integrated acoustic shim on the headpiece. The pedestals create a cavity between the sub-deck and the paving/decking surface which helps ventilate the structure and allows services such as pipes and cables to be hidden from view.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Universal Extra Adjustable Pedestal for Decking and PavingSuitable for paving and decking, including porcelain tiles on flat roofs and podiumsAdjustable telescopic stem for precise height adjustmentsUniversal Extra pedestals are freestanding, meaning no fixings through the membraneIdeal for warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systemsIntegrated acoustic shim on the headpieceCreates a cavity for ventilation and hiding pipes and cablesHeight markings every 10mm on stems for easy adjustmentEach pedestal includes an extension shankMaximum load is 11,493 N (1,171 kg)Wallbarn's Universal EXTRA pedestals give installers greater flexibility when working across surfaces with very large differences in deck level as the height range is far greater across just three products: 85mm-135mm, 125mm-215mm and 210mm-380mm.Often installers cannot be sure exactly where the fall will be on the roof or by how much. These pedestals have the heights marked out every 10mm on the side of stems, so users can see at a glance the exact height they are adjusting to without having to constantly re-measure. Each EXTRA pedestal comes complete with an extension shank which clicks into the baseplate. The threaded stem is then placed into the top of it. Paving applicationsPositioning lugs create uniform spacing between each slab, allowing rainwater to run between and under the slabs, so no standing water is left on the surfaceBeing a suspended system, the weight of the slab holds everything in placeHeight adjustments can be made whilst the slab is in place, saving time and labour10mm high lugs mean they are ideal for supporting thin tilesLugs can be snapped by hand for stretcher bond and irregular laying patternsLaying deckingAdjusting the height of the pedestals, rather than cutting furring's means installers can install decking onto structural decks much more quicklyPedestals are adjusted to accommodate the fall in the roof deckPlaced a maximum of 600mm apart, the joist bearers are simply slotted between the joist holdersA joist framework is constructed to create a sturdy, stable, weight-bearing surface to take the upper surfacingThe top decking is then fixed onto the joists using ordinary wood screws or hidden fixingsHeight adjustments can be made whilst the timber joist framework is in place, saving time and labourRaising the decking off the sub-deck allows water to drain freely under the decking so there is no standing water left on the surface, preventing ponding and associated slip hazards, and extending the lifespan of the timber.Joists are not standing directly on the waterproofing membrane, or insulation, preventing damage to it.

product.name: Wallbarn Protecto-Drain 20m Cavity Drain Membrane
product.description: The Wallbarn Protecto-Drain 8 Cavity Drain Membrane is a perfect solution for safeguarding foundations, basements, and subterranean structures. product.name: Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Pedestal For Decking and Paving
product.description: Available in a selection of height options, this Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Paving and Decking Support from Wallbarn is designed to form flat surfaces for paved or decked structures. While especially suited to use alongside porcelain tiles on podiums and flat roofs, these pedestals provide adjustments that are precise to the millimetre with the telescopic stem across various flat surfaces.The free-standing system requires no fixings, in turn sparing below membranes from hindrance and suiting warm roofs and inverted waterproofing systems. The pedestals create a gap between the paving or decking and the sub-deck for the purpose of ventilation, while effectively hiding unpleasant pipes and cables.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Universal Adjustable Pedestal For Decking and PavingVirgin fibre injection moulded polypropylene structureCompressive Strength between +20°C and -40°CCost-effective and sturdyEnd of Linear Behaviour: 6,700N = 683kgWeight Tolerance: Maximum Load 11,493 N = 1,171kg200mm base plate diameter and 120mm headpiece diameter55mm distance between lugs which are 10mm x 2mm (4mm upon request)-40°C to 75°CIntegrated acoustic shim on the headpieceLaying DeckingAdjusting the pedestal height instead of cutting furring’s quickens installation and accommodates falls in the roof deck. Joist bearers easily slot between joist holders when situated a maximum of 600mm apart. A joist framework is formed for a sturdy, stable, weight-bearing surface to take the upper surfacing and the top decking can then be fixed onto the joists with wood screws or discrete fixings. You can make height adjustments when the timber joist framework is in place to reduce both time and labour. Raising the decking off the sub-deck lets water drain beneath the decking to: avoid standing water on the surface, prolong timber lifespan, stop ponding, and limit resulting slip hazards. Joists are not standing directly on the waterproofing membrane, or insulation, to avoid damage.Standards & CertificationConforms to quality management systems standard UNI EN ISO 9001 2008Fire rating classed as 'EUROCLASSE E' according to EN 135011 2009.

product.name: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain Outlet
product.description: Available in different lengths and diameters, this perforated roof drain outlet from Wallbarn is made of flexible and strong TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer). It works to add a waterproof element to drainage holes on both balconies and roofs that are already equipped with bituminous waterproofing membranes. With resilience to weathering and UV rays, this outlet can withstand temperature changes up to 120°C and resist brittleness in lower temperatures.Where holes are made in concrete decks, this outlet is easily installed after a layer of waterproof membrane and then coated with a second layer on top of the flange - which has a perforated edge for the membrane to settle in for a secure and sturdy bond. The 240mm shank fits into an HDPE (High-density polyethylene) pipe snuggly and is slightly coned to ease the fit and provide additional stability. Water is prevented from travelling back up thanks to the two rings that emulate a drain tap, and the serrated area allows for a drain guard to join the system.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn TPE Perforated Roof Drain OutletMade from TPE (Thermoplastic elastomer) for durability, resilience, and waterproofingInstalled alongside two layers of a waterproofing membranePerforated flange to help bondingConed shank with serrated area to ease installation and allow for drain guardsUV stable and able to withstand high (120°C) and low temperatures.Compatible with SBS (Styrene Butadiene Styrene) and APP (Atactic Polypropylene Membrane) membranes, such as built-up (felt), hot melt, mastic asphalt, and other liquid-applied membranes.Please note: Do not allow direct contact with concrete as this can allow water to find its way beneath the outlet and cause damage.Assure that a layer of membrane is fully bonded to the outlet flange and the first layer for completely watertight bonds.

product.name: Wallbarn TPE Extension Shank
product.description:
Wallbarn extension shanks are designed to fix up with the drainage outlets to increase the reach into the parapet wall or drainage channel.
Often the ducts and channels will have to pass through a long run of concrete before reaching a suitable area to install the HDPE drainpipe, so an extension of a fully waterproof sealed connector will be required. These extension shanks are specially designed to fit in with the full range of Wallbarn circular outlets.
They are made from TPE but can still be used with EPDM and PVC outlets. They are manufactured to a slight cone shape, so the end of the circular outlet slots inside the top of the extension shank. The two membranes are bonded together using silicone adhesive.
Please note: Installers of PVC waterproofing systems should always inform waterproofing manufacturer before using these two materials together in order check the status of the warranty.

product.name: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable Pedestal
product.description: The specially designed Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA adjustable pedestals are ideal for decking and paving projects. The self-levelling headpieces have been developed to give extra scope and flexibility, so differences are accommodated within the surface beneath the pedestal. The BALANCE also helps alleviate blemishes and ridges in the sub-deck or changes in the thickness of your paving slabs which makes the upper surface uneven.Whereas BALANCE pedestals are available in heights from 25mm up to 395mm, BALANCE EXTRA pedestals give an extended height range from 100mm up to 395mm in just three different products.Features & Benefits: Wallbarn BALANCE EXTRA Adjustable PedestalIdeal for decking and pavingEasier and faster than old fashioned methodsSpecially designed to give extra scope and flexibilityHeight: 222mm - 392mm, 137mm - 227mm, 97mm - 147mmType: AdjustableThis suspended system uses the weight of the slab or decking to hold everything into place. Rainwater runs between and underneath, so there is no standing water left on the surface of your floor. This dramatically reduces the risk of slipping and causing serious injury.You can hide unsightly objects such as cables, water pipes and drainage outlets underneath the paving slabs as well, improving the aesthetics of your floor.Decking ApplicationsWhen used with timber decking systems, the lugs(fins) are set out towards the edges of the headpiece to give a 55mm gap between each one. This allows a timber joist to fit between the lugs (fins), and then decking boards are can be fixed to the joist frame. Installers are able to create decking surfaces onto structural decks much faster by adjusting the height of pedestals rather than cutting furrings.Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece design has four positioning lugs (fins) laid out in a crucifix formation set towards the edges of the headpiece. The design means that it robust, stable and durable. The headpiece has separate parts that allow up to 5% or 2.86 degrees of slope correction in all directions. This allows smooth movement and positioning of the paving slab. Slips and sharp tilting are avoided owing to the superior design and solid manufacture. The lugs (fins) separate paving slabs and tiles on the headpiece to allow sufficient drainage between slabs, which create a uniform paving line, so the slabs are laid entirely straight. A rubber anti-shock pad can slot onto the headpiece to give a better grip to the slab and help insulate against vibration and noise travelling through to the deck beneath.Please note: Shims, slope correctors, cross spacers and other accessories can also be used with the BALANCE Pedestals.

product.description: Wallbarn's Mega Balance Self-Levelling Pedestals are an easy-to-install four-in-one solution that you can use in various applications, thanks to its ingenious headpiece design that supports not only decking joists and bearers but also paving slabs and tiles.With a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mm, this heavy-duty suspended system means the weight of the paving slabs or tiles ballasts themselves securely into position. Each pedestal is made from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillers, which will provide long-term durability and performance. They have even been laboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures. Features & Benefits: Wallbarn Mega Balance Self-Levelling Paving & Decking PedestalAn easy-to-install pedestal that supports both decking boards and paving slabs/tilesA self-levelling and fixed head pedestal all in oneHas a weight tolerance of over two tonnes per unit and a height range of 25mm up to 1025mmSelf-levelling headpiece moves up to 5% or 2.86° in all directionsYou can adjust your pedestals slightly even after a project has been completed, saving on labour and improving health and safetyThe ‘grey nut’ can be pressed into the centre of the headpiece to lock the self-levelling mechanism should installers require fixed headsThe headpiece comes with an integrated rubber anti-shock pad, which clicks into place to give a better grip and improves vibration and noise insulationMade from non-hazardous, fully recyclable injection moulded polypropylene without fillersLaboratory tested at -40°C to +75°C to prove they will not shatter in sub-zero temperatures1 black nut for every four units purchased.While the headpiece is self-levelling as standard, by using the 'grey nut', the head can be locked rigid within the same unit. If you need to adjust the height of your pedestals, you can do this using the 'yellow' and 'silver' key tools, even on a completed paving project, without having to lift and remove any of the slabs.For Paving ApplicationsThe self-levelling headpiece incorporates 4 x 4mm wide positioning lugs (fins) integrated with the headpiece, helping to create a uniform paving line for your slabs and tiles. Not only does it aid the overall aesthetic of your paving, but with the headpiece’s lugs separating your tiles, this allows for improved drainage. To install, simply lay the paving slab or tile onto one segment of the headpiece so four corners of your paving slabs or tiles rest on each headpiece. This will ensure four pedestals support each corner of a slab or tile, providing stable and secure support. For Decking ApplicationsThe four positioning lugs on the self-levelling headpiece are set 55mm apart so a 50mm wide joist/bearer can be loose-laid between them easily. It is loose-laid rather than mechanically fixed in case of expansion or movement, which can cause differences between the structure beneath and the decking over time. The lugs are high enough to house the joists securely, giving you flexibility in your decking project. When laying your decking, the joists/bearers should be cross-fitted together to form a secure framework. The upper surface decking boards can then be mechanically fixed to the joist frame according to the specification and assembly instructions of the deck board supplier. Standards & CertificationFire Classification: EUROCLASS E according to EN 13501-1-2009Please note: You will only receive 1 black nut for every four units purchased. Additional black Nuts can be purchased.In decking applications, there is no need to cut furrings as the pedestals are adjusted in height to create a flat frame level.The headpiece is self-levelling as standard. Installers may or may not wish to click the grey nut into the headpiece to lock the head, depending on the characteristics of the decking project.There are cut lines on the underside of the baseplates should installers need to pave directly up to walls or parapets - do not cut bases beyond these cut lines.Special CLASS B1 (EN 13501-1-2009) rated pedestals can be manufactured upon request.

For surface water applications only. Complies with HAPAS BBA.
Twin Wall drainage pipe is made from HDPE plastic and is available from 100mm to 3000mm diameters. Manufactured by a twin extrusion process in which two layers are simultaneously extruded, one inside the other and heat welded together in one continuous process. The outer wall is corrugated providing excellent structural strength which reduces the possibility of on-site damage. The inner wall has a smooth seamless finish to assist hydraulic flow. This design, unlike traditional single-wall pipe prevents silt accumulation.
Benefits of Twin Wall include:

Lightweight 6 metre long lengths
Strong (Twin Walled & corrugated)
Smooth inner wall for increased flow capacity
Resistant to naturally occuring chemicals
Can be installed at depths from 0.5 to 10 metres
BBA and HAPAS Roads & Bridges Agrément Certificate No. 02/H069
Reduced plant & labour costs
Faster installation as 6 metre lengths mean fewer joints
Elimination of waste compared to traditional pipe
Pipe is easily cut to size requirements on site
A full range of bends of all angles & both equal & unequal junctions are also available

product.name: Marsh Whisspurr W-AVR Acoustic Vibration Reduction Unit
product.description:
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reaction (AVR) unit has been designed to limit noise levels and vibrations from diaphragm compressors used in the water and wastewater treatment sectors.
Suitable for all types of compressor including; Bibus Secoh, Nitto and Charles Austen, the Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit is easily fitted inline between the compressor and air diffuser. If space permits, the Marsh Whisspurr unit should be fitted as close as possible to the compressor – preferably, inside the sewage treatment plant.
Please note, the Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit is chemically sealed and bolted shut, which creates a pressure vacuum when in operation. Any tampering, breaking of the seal, or removal of any bolts will invalidate the warranty and will prevent the unit from working effectively. This unit is also not suitable for side channel blowers.
What are the benefits of the Marsh Whisppurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit?
The Marsh Whisspurr Acoustic Vibration Reduction unit’s innovative design ensures that any noise pollution emanating from the compressor unit is dramatically reduced without hindering the overall performance of the treatment system. Rural areas, where continuous noise is a nuisance, particularly benefits from AVR unit’s noise and vibration reduction qualities.
Available in four standard sizes, the corrosion free Marsh Whisspurr AVR unit does not require any electrics and can be easily installed into existing wastewater and water treatment systems.
Features and Benefits

Innovative UK design (patent pending).
Significantly reduces compressor volume and vibration without reducing in air pressure from the compressor.
No increase in back pressure to the compressor.
The unit contains no moving parts and requires no electrics.
Can be easily retrofitted to existing compressors.
Hose tail is 20mm standard.
Ideal for rural areas where noise pollution is a nuisance.
Available in four standard sizes.
Manufactured from resin and glass polymer, making the unit corrosion free and invulnerable to warm/humid conditions.
Unit is dark green as standard.

Specification
Overall unit width: 142mm
Overall unit height (excluding hose tail):200mm240mm350mm450mm
Material (unit): Resin and Glass Polymer
Material (hose tail connections): Brass with Stainless Steel nuts and bolts.
Colour: Dark Green

product.name: Marsh Cesspool Cesspit Tank
product.description:
The Marsh cesspool cesspit tank is a covered, watertight unit for storing raw household sewage. It has no outlet and relies on road transport for the removal of raw sewage. No biological treatment is involved.

Heavy duty shell as standard to enable installation in all ground conditions
Integral lifting eyes for improved on-site handling
Unique ‘keying-in’ lip to assist anchoring into granular or concrete surround

Modern environmental regulations either discourage or ban the use of cesspools (Cesspools are not permitted in Scotland), and instead connections to municipal sewage systems or package sewage treatment plants are encouraged or required.In many countries, planning and development regulations for the protection of the environment prevent home-owners who live close to rivers and environmentally sensitive areas from installing a cesspit or septic system, requiring a sewage treatment plant instead.
Please note, whoever empties your cesspool should be a registered Waste Carrier and hold a current discharge licence from the local water authority.

product.name: Marsh Portapurra Temporary Pumped Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The portable and compact Portapura sewage treatment tank from Marsh Industries has been specifically designed for temporary accommodation (caravans/travel homes), site offices, site toilets and workshops. The Portapura can be installed above or below ground and treats domestic wastewater to a level that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard.
What are the benefits of choosing Marsh Portapura?
This compact and portable sewage treatment tank is designed specifically for temporary buildings. Design objectives included performance, running costs, installation, transport and storage, making the Portapura the logical choice for sites where temporary buildings are required.
The Portapura’s compact design provides quick and easy installation (where below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours) with minimum visual impact on the surrounding landscape as well as simple and safe access for maintenance and cleaning.  Systems can be installed above ground and removed/stored when not in use.
The cost of installing and running the Portapura is minimal when compared to larger, commercial systems making it one of the more cost-effective sewage treatment tanks on the market.
Another benefit of choosing the Portapura sewage treatment tank is its impact on the environment. Being CE?approved to BS EN 12566 with an ammonia result that is 25 times better than the recommended EN standard means the Portapura is well within discharge consent requirements.
Technical

Available in three sizes - 2, 3 or 5 person units (gravity or pumped outlet)
Compact, lightweight construction - No heavy plant required
Portable
Cost effective installation - Below ground installation can be achieved in approximately 2 hours
Outstanding treatment efficiency - 14:19:0.7mg/ltr (BOD:Suspended solids:Ammonia)
Near silent air compressor - Ensures minimal running, maintenance and servicing costs
Electrical consumption: 1.8kWh/d - Equivalent to the daily use of a lightbulb
CE?approved to BS?EN 12566
Fire resistance tested in accordance with EN ISO 11925-2:210
Tested for structural integrity in accordance with EN ISO 179-1/1eA
Neck extensions are available for deeper installations

Do not install a Portapura treatment plant in water logged or uneven ground.
Do not remove the covers of the Portapura, or access the unit in any way, without firstly isolating the mains power.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description: The Ensign domestic sewage treatment plant comes with lifting eyes to make unloading and installation faster and safer. We designed the Ensign plant to self-level on the base and with our unique pipe connections ensure the installation is undertaken efficiently and correctly. The six person Ensign Sewage plant is extremely strong and is only 1.95m in depth with an inlet invert of 500mm, this design reduces both the time and cost of installation, in normal ground conditions the unit only requires a pea-shingle surround. For guidance ideally the Ensign plant should be 7m from a dwelling or10m from a stream.Package Sewage Treatment Plants (or PSTP's) are often a suitable option where groundwater in the surrounding environment is vulnerable, drainage field percolation values are restrictive, or direct discharge to watercourse or surface water sewer is the preferred discharge method. Marsh Industries Ensign range of sewage treatment plants treat final effluent to British and European Standards to allow it to be discharged back into the watercourse whilst reaching national consent standards. Our tanks can be manufactured with either a gravity or pumped outlet to meet your site requirements. At Marsh Industries we only use 100% virgin resin (no chalk fillers) in all our products. Lead times for Domestic Sewage Treatment Plants are normally only 5-7 working days. Comes with external compressor as standard.Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Ultra Advanced Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantNo moving partsLow running and maintenance costsEasy installation with keying-in lip and lifting eyesTested and certified to BSEN12566-350 year design life25 year structural guaranteeThe Ensign plant has been tested to EN12566:3-2005Highest testing standard for European testingThe Ensign can discharge direct to a ditch, watercourse or percolation bedSuitable for One 4 bed residence & Two 3 Bed Residences - 16 People or 25 people working.In addition to anaerobic digestion taking place in the primary settlement chamber the Ensign: Ultra unit allows the clarified water to pass into a second 'aeration' chamber where it is treated to remove the dissolved constituents. Here aerobic bacteria supported by diffused air and mobile media, ensures full treatment is achieved before the treated effluent and 'sloughed off' bacteria flows to a final settlement chamber. The final effluent is then discharged to the drainage field or watercourse via polylok filter.Please note: External Cabinet can be supplied free of charge, please state when ordering.

product.name: Marsh:Standard Commercial Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants are a cost-effective way of treating sewage and wastewater in an off-mains area. For large residential, commercial and industrial sites, including leisure sites, Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants will provide biological processing for effluent until it’s of a quality well within the British Water effluent standard.
This sewage treatment plant will provide effluent treatment for up to 85 people. Manufactured in the UK, the tank is made from GRP virgin unfilled resin to provide a durable and structurally secure tank that has consistent wall thickness and no fillers in the material. Built this way in part as a safety feature, Marsh:Standard plants also have turret guards and failure alarms for extra peace of mind.
A low energy compressor and high specification bacteria keep the Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plant running smoothly as the bacteria along with membrane diffusers ensure the circulation of effluent so that it’s all treated. The low energy compressor minimises running costs whilst the system needs minimal maintenance as the system itself has no moving parts.
Approved to BS12566, the heavy duty shell provides a long life for Marsh:Standard sewage treatment plants. Alarms and 600mm lockable manhole covers are as standard.

product.name: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description:
The Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant is an effective solution for sewage treatment, designed to accommodate areas where a natural gravity flow is not feasible. By opting for a pumped treatment plant, the system will efficiently direct effluent to higher levels, ensuring an economical and environmentally friendly operation.
When installed correctly, the Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment Plant operates virtually odour-free and near-silently, also offering a discreet design that will not create eyesores in your garden or outdoor spaces. It is recommended Ensign plants are positioned at a minimum distance of seven metres from a dwelling or ten metres from a stream.
Features & Benefits: Marsh Ensign Pumped Domestic Sewage Treatment PlantAn effective and environmentally friendly pumped solution for sewage treatment in areas without gravity flowEfficiently directs effluent to higher levels using a pumpDiscrete design, virtually odour-free and operates near-silentlyFeatures lifting eyes for easy unloading and self-levelling on the base for easy installationUnique pipe connections for efficient and cost-effective installationTreats effluent to British and European Standards25-year structural guarantee
Featuring lifting eyes, this treatment plant facilitates quick and safe unloading, while its self-levelling capability on the base ensures ease of installation. The unique and innovative pipe connections enable efficient and cost-effective installation, catering to various property sizes.
The Ensign range of sewage treatment plants excels in treating final effluent to both British and European Standards, meeting national consent standards for discharge into watercourses. Manufactured with 100% virgin resin, excluding chalk fillers, this plant prioritises sustainability. It has undergone rigorous testing, adhering to the highest European testing standard, EN12566:3-2005, enabling direct discharge to ditches, watercourses, or percolation beds.
Standards & CertificationEuropean Standard: EN 12566 3-2005
Please note: External Cabinet as standard. Fitted with an internal pumped outlet and will do a max head of 3m and 50m pumped distance. Outlet is 32mm MDPE.

product.name: Marsh Sump2Drain Sewage Pump Station with 6m Head - Single Pump
product.description: The Marsh Sump2Drain Sewage Pump Station is a compact, foul water pumping solution designed for properties where gravity drainage isn't possible. Supplied ready to install with a submersible 50mm solid handling pump, it provides reliable 24-hour operation.Ideal for extensions, garden rooms, basements and small conversions, the Sump2Drain efficiently transfers foul or grey water to a septic tank, treatment plant or the mains sewer. Made from corrosion-resistant GRP, with a moulded keying-in lip that anchors securely into concrete, the station is supplied as a complete unit with twin pumps so it can operate on an automatic duty/assist cycle to provide dependable performance. And for extra peace of mind, each twin pump model comes with a high-level alarm, essential for monitoring water levels and preventing failure.Suitable for larger domestic properties and light commercial applications, the system collects wastewater from toilets, kitchens, showers and appliances before discharging it safely to the mains sewer, septic tank or treatment plant. product.name: Lindab Magestic Half Round Galvanised Steel Downpipe Connector
product.description: This Magestic downpipe connector is available in a range of diameters to connect two downpipes together, providing a male/female connection. Manufactured from galvanised steel with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating offers the greatest surface protection for this coated steel connector which ages superbly, settling into an attractive dark grey metallic appearance after 3-5 years from installation.With elite galvanisation, this connector uses magnesium to create a stable barrier, protecting zinc’s porous structure against corrosion issues with salt spray tests demonstrating more than 20 times the corrosion resistance of zinc galvanised steel without magnesium. With improved edge protection, this connector’s galvanised coating migrates to repair red rust on scratches and cuts with self-healing properties and has ultimate resistance in aggressive environments with more than 3 times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. product.name: Lindab Magestic Galvanised Steel Gutter
product.description: This half-round gutter has been roll-formed with 0.6mm thick steel and has a bead stiffened front. Quick and easy to join using click and lock gutter joints or a roll joint method, this gutter is available in a range of diameters and lengths to fit your building and Magestic half round gutter requirements.Made with a strengthening magnesium zinc alloy coating to galvanise this steel gutter’s surface, provides the ultimate surface protection. This superior galvanisation with magnesium protects the porous structure of zinc, creating a stable barrier against corrosion. With over twenty times the corrosion resistance of standard zinc galvanised steel without magnesium, demonstrated when salt spray tested, this gutter has improved edge protection with self-healing properties from the galvanised coating which migrates to repair red rust on cuts and scratches.Features & Benefits: Lindab Magestic Galvanised Steel GutterQuick and easy to install  Made to last with minimal thermal movement  Weathers naturally to a dark grey metallic surface  Resistant to corrosion and vandalism  Low environmental impact with reduced consumption of zinc steel  Affordable and cost-effective  Enhanced surface protection with magnesium zinc alloy and self-healing properties  Not influenced by the chlorine content of an environment  Suitable for coastal environments  Range of lengths and diameters availableSettling into an attractive dark grey metallic appearance, this gutter ages superbly after 3-5 years from installation. With more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanised steel in marine settings, this gutter has the ultimate resistance when faced with aggressive environments.  This gutter has a stylish design, suitable for a variety of buildings including large or small, contemporary or classic buildings. This gutter is intended for long-term use and the recyclable steel material ensures that the environment is never second best. This steel can be repurposed and still maintains its properties, with a low impact on zinc resources.Standards & CertificationFulfils A1 according to EN 13501-1:2007+A1: 2009

product.name: Lindab Magestic Rectangular Galvanised Steel Intermediate Downpipe
product.description: This intermediate pipe easily cuts into suitable pieces for your required lengths. Typically used to make an offset with less than 100mm projection, this downpipe can be cut to make two short pipes. The 1m length option is supplied with double spigot male ends while the 0.5m downpipe is supplied with male/female ends.This downpipe is available in a range of diameters to fit your Magestic round downpipes. Made from galvanised steel, this downpipe has a strengthening magnesium zinc alloy coating which provides the highest surface protection for coated steel surfaces. Ageing superbly, this downpipe settles into an attractive dark grey metallic exterior after 3-5 years from installation. Providing elite galvanisation with magnesium, this downpipe has a stable barrier against corrosion issues and protects the porous structure of zinc. This downpipe demonstrates more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of standard zinc galvanised steel without magnesium when salt spray tested. product.description: This bracket is ideal for securing the Magestic galvanised steel half round gutters by fixing to vertical fascia boards. product.name: Lindab Magestic Round Galvanised Steel Rafter Bracket
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System
10 Year Warranty

product.name: Lindab Half Round Steel Self-Locking Stop End
product.description: Lindab’s painted Half Round self-locking stop ends go at the end of guttering runs and are completely universal – they can be used both left and right-handed. product.name: Lindab 330mm Half Round Steel Flex-Fit Rafter Bracket
product.description: This flex-fit rafter bracket has metal clips in the back and front, making for a very forgiving assembly phase. product.description: This flex-fit rafter bracket has metal clips in the back and front, making for a very forgiving assembly phase. product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Naylor's land drain pipe filter sock geotextile is a great addition to pipe systems. Particularly in sandy and silty soil conditions.A special knit fabric, this sock allows very fine soil particles to pass through and into the perforated pipe, then subsequently discharged from the drainage pipe with water. The fabric prevents larger soil particles from passing through the fabric, causing a bridge against each other on the outer surface of the fabric. An example of this is granular backfill materials.  The bridging effect of these soil particles improves the permeability of the native backfill materials and immediately surrounds the perforated drainage pipe.Features & Benefits: Naylor Land Drain Pipe Filter Sock GeotextileSuitable for sandy and silty soil conditionsKnit fabricPrevents large soil particles from passing throughAllows fine soil particles to pass through

product.description:

product.description:
An excellent alternative to traditional clayware and concrete pipes, this lightweight and high-performance corrugated HDPE Naylor MetroDrain Twinwall Surface Water Pipe is a high-strength solution designed for use with all non-pressure, surface and sub-surface storm water drainage applications.

MetroDrain is also ideal for use in environmental systems, such as soakaways, pump and sampling chambers and stormwater attenuation systems.

product.name: Naylor Land Drain Pipe 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile
product.description: Designed to complement Naylor Land Drain Pipes, this 50mm Filter Sock Geotextile is made from a specially knit fabric, which offers a unique solution by allowing ultra-fine soil particles to effortlessly flow through, joining the perforated pipe. As water flows, these fine particles are efficiently carried away, ensuring optimal drainage performance. What's more, this Filter Sock Geotextile also plays a crucial role in retaining larger soil particles. These particles, unable to pass through the fabric, create a bridging effect on its outer surface. This not only provides additional structural support but also enhances the permeability of the surrounding native backfill materials, mimicking the benefits of granular backfill. This geotextile is especially well-suited for sand and silty soil conditions. This shorter rafter bar is ideal for refurbishment installations and is available in a range of sizes to fit and secure the Steel Painted Half Round gutters by fixing to roof rafters, recommended at a maximum of 800mm interval spacing. This gutter angle is suitable for a variety of applications including large or small, classic or contemporary buildings with roof features such as recesses or extensions. This superior steel gutter angle is robust, lightweight and long-lasting. Inexpensive and virtually maintenance free

Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
Lindab steel guttering can be fitted to new builds and refurbishments to offer a subtle and light-coloured guttering system that isn’t obtrusive or distracting from the overall aesthetic of the property. With a 70-year life expectancy, HB polyester painted guttering won’t split, leak, shrink or fade and the 275g layer of zinc that this steel guttering is coated in won’t discolour or rust.
Extremely low maintenance, Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering is modern and inexpensive, perfect for homeowners who need longevity and durability from their guttering system without the hassle of constant maintenance. This system only needs the occasional wipe down. The steel guttering itself is made from galvanized steel guttering, coated in zinc for extra durability, and the HB polyester paint is warrantied for 15 years. To ensure safety and security this HB polyester painted steel guttering can be fit flush to walls so people can’t use it to scale up buildings.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel Downpipe Conical Bend
product.description:
Conical pipe bends provide a way of overcoming facade features or to offset pipe stacks whilst maintaining the aesthetics of your Lindab Rainline gutter system. The clean lines and conical shape combine to blend in with the system whilst allowing a male/female connection. Male spigot ends of pipes and outlets can fit perfectly in the top of the bend while the bottom fits into a standard pipe.
This bend provides a 70° angle.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
This system can be used for new buildings and refurbishment projects to match any external decoration. It could also be used as a subtle guttering system and installed in projects where guttering needs to appear discreet. HB polyester painted guttering from the Lindab Rainline collection is coated with a layer of 275g of zinc that won't discolour or rust, meaning this guttering system offers a solution that won't split, leak, shrink or fade.
This modern and cost-effective half round guttering system is low maintenance, requiring only the occasional wipe down. It's the perfect solution for homeowners who don't want the fuss of constant upkeep but would like to install a durable, long-lasting gutter system. Manufactured from lightweight galvanized steel, the gutters and downpipes can be fit flush to the wall in order to avoid people climbing the building.
All guttering in the HB polyester painted Lindab Rainline range comes with a 15-year warranty on the HB polyester painted coating and has a 70-year life expectancy.

Conical pipe bends provide a way of overcoming facade features or to offset pipe stacks whilst maintaining the aesthetics of your Lindab Rainline gutter system. The clean lines and conical shape combine to blend in with the system whilst allowing a male/female connection. Male spigot ends of pipes and outlets can fit perfectly in the top of the bend while the bottom fits into a standard pipe.
This bend provides a 70° angle.
Lindab HB polyester painted steel guttering
This system can be used for new buildings and refurbishment projects to match any external decoration. It could also be used as a subtle guttering system and installed in projects where guttering needs to appear discreet. HB polyester painted guttering from the Lindab Rainline collection is coated with a layer of 275g of zinc that won't discolour or rust, meaning this guttering system offers a solution that won't split, leak, shrink or fade.
This modern and cost-effective half round guttering system is low maintenance, requiring only the occasional wipe down. It's the perfect solution for homeowners who don't want the fuss of constant upkeep but would like to install a durable, long-lasting gutter system. Manufactured from lightweight galvanized steel, the gutters and downpipes can be fit flush to the wall in order to avoid people climbing the building.
All guttering in the HB polyester painted Lindab Rainline range comes with a 15-year warranty on the HB polyester painted coating and has a 70-year life expectancy.

product.name: Lindab Leafline Gutter Brush
product.description:
Available in 3 metre continuous lengths and in three diameters (100mm, 125mm and 150mm), Leafline is easy to install. Simply place one or more in your guttering; they even bend around corners. No special tools or training are required and it only takes a matter of minutes. The leafline gutter brush is virtually indestructible, made of stainless steel wire core with polypropylene bristles, so it will be years before you have to think about this problem again.
Features

Prevents leaves and debris build-up in guttering.
Stops birds and rodents entering loft spaces.
Easily fitted in minutes, even around corners.
Virtually indestructible and maintenance free.
Suitable for most domestic gutters.
Cost-effective.

This extra-durable, high-build polyester paint coating provides protection, extending the life expectancy of this downpipe bend to an excess of 70 years with low maintenance requirements. product.name: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset
product.description:
The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

product.name: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset
product.description:
The steel painted round one-piece offset by Lindab is used to 'offset' a pipe stack, joining the gutter outlet or to traverse a plinth. Available with a fixed 100mm projection. Lindab’s round one-piece offset is smart and low-maintenance thanks to resilient, scratch-resistant polyester paint. It also comes with UV stability which means the colour can last for years to come. The Lindab one-piece offset is part of the popular Rainline™ range. Rainline is a sustainable range that has been tested and proven to offer the lowest carbon footprint rainwater system of any competitor. It is manufactured from 30% recycled material and is totally recyclable, meaning the environmental impact of steel is minor compared to plastic or other material. Manufacturing materials used in RainlineTM also means lasting solutions with systems being able to last up 70 years. 
Features & Benefits: Lindab Round Steel One Piece Offset SOKN one-piece offset with fixed 100mm projectionLow environmental impact over its lifetime than other metalsManufactured from 30% recycled material for easy recyclingUV stability helps minimise colour fadingLow maintenance saving time and costsHigh resistance to corrosion and vandalismCost-effective with a 15-year warranty as part of the Rainline™ painted systems range
Please note: 15-year warranty does not apply to unpainted finishes. Use of the Lindab steel painted one-piece offset in coastal regions where salt water is present is also not advised as it can risk a corrosive reaction. In this instance, a coated system should be used.

product.name: Lindab Square Steel Large Water Hopper
product.description: Brought to you by Lindab, this steel-painted large square water hopper is a traditional-style hopper for installations of the same aesthetic. Part of Lindab's rainwater systems range, this hopper is suitable for when a standing seam is installed on the roof. Manufactured using powder-coated galvanised steel with 0.6mm thickness, this hopper has been carefully developed to pair with pre-coated material. So there is no contrast in design when it comes to fitting full systems together. Moreover, by opting for steel, this is a lighter material than cast iron and easier to handle than aluminium. It also offers minimal thermal movement compared to plastic which is at risk of moving and cracking which can cause leaks. product.name: Lindab Steel Downpipe Self Cleaning Leaf Trap
product.description:
Self cleaning leaf filter in HD polythene for down pipes.
When it comes to creating beautiful, environmentally friendly and maintenance free buildings, using the right materials is everything. The Lindab Rainline Steel Rainwater system uses the very best in lightweight galvanised steel to create a contemporary, cost effective and eco-friendly guttering system that won't shrink, split or leak and looks great too.
Each piece of core steel is coated with 275g zinc per square metre, a naturally self-healing coating that won't discolour or rust. The coating on both our High Build Polyester and Aluzinc guttering systems, are guaranteed for 15 years with a life expectancy in excess of 70 years.
Rainline is ideal for modern and traditional buildings for both refurbishments and new build projects. Gutters and downpipes simply push together without the need for any special tools or sealants.
The SLS fits directly into a 110mm Drain point, simply slides inside.
When you have a different diameter downpipe entering the SLS from above, you will need to purchase a BUTK drain shoe which allows for this connection to be achieved.
Properties

Steel is the ultimate material for roof-drainage systems.
It is much lighter than cast iron, is easier to handle than aluminium and offers minimal thermal movement compared to plastic (which can move and crack causing leaks).
Lindab's steel also has the lowest CO2 impact of any competitor.

Low maintenance

The only maintenance required is an occasional wipe or wash down.
Easy assembly and installation guarantee a long service life.

Vandal resistant

Highly resistant to attack from vandals - can be fixed flush to a wall to prevent anyone climbing up the downpipe

Minimum environmental impact

Tests have proven that Rainline steel systems reflect the lowest cradle-to-grave impact by minimizing the use of raw materials, components, energy, packaging and transport.

Cost-effective solution

Competitively priced against leading plastic systems and inexpensive compared with aluminium and cast iron.

product.name: Lindab Magestic Rectangular Galvanised Steel Regular Water Hopper
product.description:
Lindab Magestic is an improved galvanised steel material for rainwater system and standing seam applications. Magestic offers the same trusted Lindab product designs with a strengthened magnesium zinc alloy coating.
Galvanised steel is already the most environmentally friendly material used in rainwater systems. Magestic has a reduced impact on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. New technology has allowed the material to be developed using magnesium to create a stable barrier to protect zinc’s porous structure against corrosion factors. Salt spray tests demonstrate the highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Unpainted metal gutters naturally weather organically adjusting to the installation environment. Magestic settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation.
Magestic corrosion in not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests demonstrate more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Galvanised coatings migrate to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation.
Features

New elite, strengthed magnesium alloy coating
Highest surface protection of any metallic coated steel
Improved performance in coastal environments
Lowest price Lindab Rainwater System

Dimensions
Length: 250mm.Width: 150mm.Height: 150mm.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: This half round 3m gutter assembly gives you everything required to incorporate a guttering run into the rest of your aluminium Aqualine half round guttering by Alumasc. Alongside the guttering run itself, you will receive adequate union clips, side locks, and brackets for installation.For applications where you want your gutter run to look modern and match the particular aesthetic you are trying to achieve, Alumasc’s Aqualine range is ideal. With a selection of polyester powder finishes, all approved by the BBA (British Board of Agrément), you will find choosing just one colour to be the trickiest part! Installation is made incredibly easy with the light and moveable aluminium structure, which is also 100% recyclable for when your gutter needs replacing – which shouldn’t be for a very long time, considering your Aqualine system’s predicted 25 to 40 year lifespan. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round 3m Gutter AssemblyAluminium extrusions (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6) made in the UK  Specially created for Aqualine half round guttering range  Includes fixings that provide support but aren’t very noticeable  Doesn’t require high levels of upkeep. This gutter run assembly can play an excellent role in your Aqualine guttering with how cost-efficient an option it is. Not to mention the high British quality, how well it performs, and how adaptable it is for a variety of current builds that require modern details.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Internal Angle
product.description: Part of Alumasc's Aqualine range, this half round internal angle is designed to be installed as a corner of a guttering system. Installation is simple, with a simple clip fix required to support the brackets once they've been attached to the building fabric with concealed bracketry and versatile dry-sealed joints using internal unions positioned by sliding lock bars. Concealed site fixing and jointing enable the internal angle to fit in with the intricate detailing and smooth lines. Ensuring a clean appearance and secure installation that compliments and enhances the architectural design of your modern building. The design is also lightweight, compact and efficient, enhancing performance and high flow capacity; fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. This prevents potential damage of cracking and splitting. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Internal AngleVariety of colours, angles and gutter diameters to choose fromBBA-approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatingsManufactured using environmentally-friendly and 100% recyclable aluminiumAluminium material is durable and non-corrodible, ensuring long-lasting use and requiring minimal maintenanceLightweight for easy handling and transportationSmooth lines, secret fix bracketry and intricate detailing ensure a clean appearance to enhance buildingsSuitable for flush and projective eaves applicationsHigh-flow capacity to enhance performanceUnique, all-weather 'dry' jointing systems gives a completely clean and secure installationManufactured in the UK using aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloys to British standards BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101When it comes to application, this guttering corner can be fitted to flush and projecting eaves applications. It is also available in various colours, angles and diameters to ensure you have the right one for your system. BBA certification also applies to the guttering as its coating is a factory-applied polyester powder. So you can rely on the quality and colour of guttering to last for years to come. At least 40 years in fact in rural and suburban areas, as well as up to 25 years in industrial and marine areas. Little maintenance is required once it has been installed. product.description: Part of Alumasc's Aqualine range, this half round internal angle is designed to be installed as a corner of a guttering system. Installation is simple, with a simple clip fix required to support the brackets once they've been attached to the building fabric with concealed bracketry and versatile dry-sealed joints using internal unions positioned by sliding lock bars. Concealed site fixing and jointing enable the internal angle to fit in with the intricate detailing and smooth lines. Ensuring a clean appearance and secure installation that compliments and enhances the architectural design of your modern building. The design is also lightweight, compact and efficient, enhancing performance and high flow capacity; fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. This prevents potential damage of cracking and splitting. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Half Round Internal AngleVariety of colours, angles and gutter diameters to choose fromBBA-approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatingsManufactured using environmentally-friendly and 100% recyclable aluminiumAluminium material is durable and non-corrodible, ensuring long-lasting use and requiring minimal maintenanceLightweight for easy handling and transportationSmooth lines, secret fix bracketry and intricate detailing ensure a clean appearance to enhance buildingsSuitable for flush and projective eaves applicationsHigh-flow capacity to enhance performanceUnique, all-weather 'dry' jointing systems gives a completely clean and secure installationManufactured in the UK using aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloys to British standards BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101When it comes to application, this guttering corner can be fitted to flush and projecting eaves applications. It is also available in various colours, angles and diameters to ensure you have the right one for your system. BBA certification also applies to the guttering as its coating is a factory-applied polyester powder. So you can rely on the quality and colour of guttering to last for years to come. At least 40 years in fact in rural and suburban areas, as well as up to 25 years in industrial and marine areas. Little maintenance is required once it has been installed. Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications, it is part of a compact yet efficient rainwater system that fully accommodates free linear thermal movement.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Stop-EndSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applicationsVariety of colours to choose from with left or right handed optionsNeat appearance with secret fix bracketryMinimal maintenance requirementsLightweight and easy to handle and installDurable and non-corrodibleEnvironmentally friendly and recyclableMade in the UK to British StandardsLife expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areasContributing to enhanced performance and high flow capacity, this stop-end comes in a variety of monochrome colours to choose from. Displaying smooth lines and intricate detailing, it is perfect for complementing and transforming the appearance and architectural character of your contemporary designed building. Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium, it is available left or right handed to complete your building’s guttering requirements.Straightforward to install providing a neat appearance, this stop-end is light and easy to handle. With secret fix bracketry and all-weather ‘dry’ jointing, the Deep Run gutters can drop and lock onto concealed brackets where internal joints are aligned. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Internal Angle
product.description: Suited exactly to Aqualine deep run guttering by Alumasc, this internal angle helps to create an uninterrupted gutter path while accommodating to turns, corners, and unprecedented angle changes at 90º or 135º. Like its half round counterparts, Alumasc’s variety of Aqualine deep run guttering is designed to withstand even higher volumes of water that you might encounter in areas with plenty of rain. Ideal for installations that require uniform colouring and sleek finishes, the Aqualine range is easy to install on a variety of eaves and features exceptionally discreet bracketry. Aluminium is recyclable and the Aqualine range, in particular, is superb at resisting cracking, corrosion, and leaks while simultaneously remaining low maintenance. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run External Angle
product.description: This deep run external angle from Alumasc’s Aqualine guttering range has all the benefits of an Aqualine half round external angle – designed to explore outwardly (external) corners of a roofline and avoid any potential obstructions – but does it with a deeper profile that can contain more water and therefore withstand a greater amount of rain. The Aqualine deep run external angle can be provided as a 90º or 135º as per your needs, and maintains a high-performing product within the strong and effective Aqualine collection. Aqualine aluminum guttering looks great on contemporary builds with the potential for hidden fixings and the fact that it can be installed either flush against the eave or slightly away from it. Made with movement from thermal change in mind, this range is innovative and modern, as well as environmentally friendly with 100% recyclable materials. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Union Clip
product.description: This Deep Run union clip can be used to join two sections of gutter together while fixed to the fascia board to support the joint. This union clip provides support for the Aqualine Deep Run extruded aluminium gutter system. Easy to install and light in weight, this union clip is available in a variety of colours with a BBA approved factory-applied polyester powder coating to complement your Deep Run gutter system.This straightforward union clip is ideal for both flush and projecting eaves applications with a unique all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system to give a clean external appearance. With a simple installation process, the Deep Run gutters have a concealed site fixing and jointing and are easy to install once the support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric with all remaining assembly fixed by a simple clip with dry sealed joints using internal unions secured by sliding lock bars to ensure a completely secure installation. This clean external appearance contributes to the smooth lines and intricate detailing, improving and complementing the architectural character and appearance of modern designed buildings. This Deep Run union clip is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running Outlet
product.description: The deep run running outlet connects the gutter and downpipe outlet in Aqualine deep run systems so that rainwater can easily continue on and flow through the drainage system without problem. Specifically for use in Alumasc’s Aqualine deep run guttering, this aluminium product comfortably allows for high volumes of water. Extruded aluminium is what makes this deep run running outlet so tough and versatile with rigorous defiance against breakage and splintering under changing weather circumstances. The deep run profile sufficiently holds and channels vast quantities of rainwater towards the drainage system, and Alumasc’s advanced technology makes for guttering that looks neat, current, and modern and that can also withstand the common changes of thermal movement at the same time. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Deep Run Running OutletVarious downpipe sizing  Deters wear and tear from impact and extended use  Corrosion resilient  Easily installed and just as easily recycled  Aqualine range is patented  Member of the deep run range  UK made with adherence to excellent British standards (BS 1474: 1972, material 6063, T6)  Multiple aesthetics can be achieved with the BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder colour choices. Compatible with several eave installations and virtually undetectable attachments, this deep run running outlet is one of many Alumasc Aqualine products that is constantly beneficial and commits to peak performance every time.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Modern Fascia Bracket
product.description: Designed to support the extruded aluminium Aqualine Modern gutter system, this fascia bracket is light and easy to install, providing a fully secure installation with smooth lines and intricate detailing for your modern designed building. With a contemporary and sleek look, this Modern gutter system will be virtually hidden from view for a clean finish.With your choice of a range of colours and sizes, this fascia bracket, with a BBA certified polyester powder that has been factory-applied, can match your Modern gutter system. Suited for both projecting eaves and flush purposes, this simple fascia bracket can effortlessly be fitted to the building fabric with all the remaining assembly required by an easy clip fix. Once mounted, this secret fix fascia bracket will remain concealed with dry sealed joints using internal unions attached by sliding lock bars for a completely secure fitting with a clean outer appearance, enhancing and complementing the architectural appeal of your building.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Modern Fascia BracketAvailable in a variety of colours and sizes to match your Modern Aqualine gutters  Made with BBA certified factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Provides support for the extruded aluminium Aqualine Modern gutter system  Made from recyclable, environmentally friendly aluminium  Made from non-corrosive and robust aluminium with minimal maintenance required  Light and easy to handle and fix  Suitable for both flush or projecting eaves  Manufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101Part of a compact and effective rainwater system, this Modern fascia bracket helps with improving the high flow capacity and performance of the Modern Aqualine gutter system, designed to accommodate thermal movement at every joint. Made from durable, non-corrodible, extruded aluminium, this straightforward bracket needs minimal maintenance once installed with a life expectancy of 40 years in rural/suburban environments and up to 25 years in industrial/marine areas.

This external moulded angle is part of Alumasc's 'Aqualine' range of guttering products, combining traditional design elements and aesthetics with highly durable modern materials to produce an excellent all-rounder for your next domestic guttering project. product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded External Angle
product.description:
This external moulded angle is part of Alumasc's 'Aqualine' range of guttering products, combining traditional design elements and aesthetics with highly durable modern materials to produce an excellent all-rounder for your next domestic guttering project. Emulating the moulded guttering profiles of period cast iron, these external angles are a perfect addition to traditional properties looking to keep their Victorian charm.However, period design no longer means putting up with the cost and added installation woes of cast iron. This range of guttering products is constructed using recycled aluminium and a long-lasting polyester powder coating approved by the British Board of Agrément (BBA). Under the right conditions, this durable combination of materials can last up to 40 years in suburban and rural areas, making for a durable and reliable system. In addition, the Aqualine range is lightweight and easy to handle, taking into account heat warping thanks to a clever notched design and keeping a watertight seal with sliding lock bars and dry joint seals.

product.description: This Alumasc Aqualine starter pack contains P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This includes all the necessary tools to help you to commence an easy and successful installation process of the Moulded extruded aluminium gutter system.This starter pack ensures a quick and easy installation using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing. This starter pack secures intricate details and smooth lines with a modern appearance for contemporary designed buildings with a completely clean outer appearance.  This lightweight and easy to handle, starter pack ensures the Moulded gutters can be locked and dropped into place onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear. Once installed, this gutter system requires minimal maintenance, made from long-lasting, durable and non-corrodible aluminium. Available in two different sizes, this starter pack is quick and easy to help you with your installation needs.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter Pack
product.description: This Alumasc Aqualine starter pack contains P80 joint seal lubricant, 2 jointing tools, 10 spare slide locks, 20 spare number 12 screws, 8 spare seal strips and 20 shims for filling gaps. This includes all the necessary tools to help you to commence an easy and successful installation process of the Moulded extruded aluminium gutter system.This starter pack ensures a quick and easy installation using a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system with concealed site fixing and jointing. This starter pack secures intricate details and smooth lines with a modern appearance for contemporary designed buildings with a completely clean outer appearance.  This lightweight and easy to handle, starter pack ensures the Moulded gutters can be locked and dropped into place onto concealed brackets with aligned and locked internal joints using lock bars located at the front and rear. This safeguards the entire gutter system is completely secure while allowing free linear thermal movement at every joint.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Starter PackQuick and easy to install your Moulded gutter system  Once support brackets have been fixed to the building fabric all remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix  Helps to enhance your building with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a completely clean appearance  Environmentally friendly and made from durable, long-life, recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to handle materials  Minimal maintenance required  Available in two different gutter diameter sizes  Made from long-lasting aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)This Moulded guttering system has a high flow capacity for enhanced performance, while this starter pack is suited to help install both flush and projecting eaves applications.  Once installed, this gutter system requires minimal maintenance, made from long-lasting, durable and non-corrodible aluminium. Available in two different sizes, this starter pack is quick and easy to help you with your installation needs.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Moulded Stop-End
product.description: This lightweight and durable stop-end is available in two different sizes, a wide selection of colours and left or right-handed, depending on the side of your installation needs. Ideal for enhancing and complementing the appearance and architectural character of your building, this moulded stop-end is part of the Aqualine system which provides smooth lines and intricate detailing to contemporary designed buildings. This moulded stop-end requires minimal maintenance once installed and is completely secure.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia Bracket
product.description: This Box Fascia Bracket has been manufactured to provide support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system. Made from durable and non-corrodible aluminium, this fascia bracket has a life expectancy of 40 years (rural/suburban areas) and up to 25 years (industrial/ marine areas) with minimal maintenance required.This lightweight, straightforward bracket is easy to install and handle. Once fixed to the building fabric, the only remaining assembly is by a simple clip fix, dropping and locking the guttering onto this concealed bracket with locked and aligned internal joints using lock bars to ensure completely secure guttering. This fascia bracket uses a unique, all-weather ‘dry’ jointing system to give a clean external appearance contributing to the smooth lines and intricate detailing to enhance and complement the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Fascia BracketManufactured in the UK to British standards  Manufactured with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  Available in a variety of colours to match your gutters  Provides support for the Aqualine Box extruded aluminium gutter system  Made from recyclable aluminium and is environmentally friendly  Manufactured from durable and non-corrodible aluminium with minimal maintenance required  Available in a range of diameters  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves  Easy to install and lightweightSuitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications and available in a wide range of sizes and in a variety of colours with BBA approved factory-applied polyester powder coatings to match your gutter system.  This Box fascia bracket is part of a compact and efficient rainwater system that enhances high flow capacity and performance and fully accommodates free linear thermal movement at every joint. The Aqualine Box guttering, supported by this fascia bracket has a box profile with a rectangular trough shape to maximise water flow capacity and gives a striking angular appearance with a uniform shape.

product.description: This internal angle guttering has been designed to fit around corners of buildings and in conjunction with the Alumasc Aqualine Box extruded aluminium guttering system to help direct the flow of rainwater into a gutter or running outlet into a water system below. This Box internal angle has a striking rectangular appearance and is shaped uniformly with a trough shape to maximise the water flow capacity around your gutters.This Box internal angle enhances and complements the appearance and architectural character of contemporary designed buildings by displaying intricate detailing and smooth lines. Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications, this internal angle contributes to an efficient and compact rainwater system. Manufactured from durable and non-corrosive aluminium and available in a range of colours, diameters and angles, this internal angle can be made to fit your gutting needs.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Aqualine Box Internal AngleManufactured in the United Kingdom to British standards  Made with aluminium extrusions 6063 T6 alloy to BS EN 573: BS EN 755, BS EN 12020 and BS 9101  BBA approved process for factory-applied polyester powder coatings  Made from recyclable aluminium and environmentally friendly  Made from robust and non-corrodible aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years for rural /suburban areas and up to 25 years for industrial/marine areas  Ideal for enhancing buildings with intricate details, smooth lines and secret fix bracketry, giving a clean appearance  Light in weight and easy to install and handle  Minimal maintenance once installed  Suitable for both flush and projecting eaves applications  High flow capacity for enhanced performance  Available in a range of colours, diameters and anglesQuick and easy to install, this lightweight internal angle uses a unique dry jointing system to give a completely clean external appearance. This Aqualine Internal angle gutter can drop and lock onto concealed brackets with locked and aligned internal joints using slide/lock bars situated at the front and rear. Ensuring a completely secure gutter system, this internal angle allows for free linear thermal movement.

product.name: Alumasc Aqualine Box Starter Pack
product.description:
This box starter pack is mainly manufactured from aluminium, and is part of the Aqualine range of aluminium guttering from Alumasc. With years of experience in the guttering and rainwater system industry, Alumasc create a range of products that, by using new technologies and manufacturing techniques, not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of quality, performance and style.
