product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of your roof, this gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run that channels the water away into a downpipe and into the rainwater system below. This high-capacity gutter is suitable for traditional or modern buildings and has been manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Moulded gutter system.Made with moulded sides and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is part of a gutter system that has been fully engineered for a traditional, well-proven installation method of simple wet sealed and bolted joints, fixed directly to your building fabric. With a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry, generally concealed after fixing, this gutter assembly is lightweight and easy to install with minimal maintenance required after installation. This gutter assembly can be exposed or designed within a Skyline fascia system, is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system and can provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Moulded 3m Gutter AssemblyMade in the UK to British Standards and pressed from sheet aluminium  Available in a selection of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with minimal maintenance required for a long-lasting installation  Made from 100% recyclable, environmentally friendly aluminium  Perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required  Available in a selection of diameters  Easy to install with a simple, well-proven method and light in weight to handle  Wet jointed and fixed directly to building fabricThis robust and non-corrodible aluminium gutter assembly can reduce the risk of heat damage, avoiding splitting and cracking by fully accommodating thermal movement at every joint. Available in a selection of diameters and colours, this gutter assembly is coated with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder to suit your gutter requirements. Made from long-lasting aluminium, this gutter assembly has a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas.

product.name: Alumasc GX Smooth 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: With this 3m gutter assembly, you will be able to successfully and easily install a guttering run that works in perfect tandem with the aluminium GX smooth guttering range from Alumasc. Including the appropriate union clips and brackets to fit the provided 3m gutter run, as well as slide locks for joints where they are necessary. The GX range is one of many brilliant guttering ranges by Alumasc. For unique designs that maintain neat finishes when installed, this collection is ideal as it features a simple screw application that can be virtually undetectable. This 3m gutter assembly fits in with the rest of GX smooth guttering and contributes to commendable rainwater drainage when correctly attached with GX union smooth clips. product.name: Alumasc GX Moulded External Angle
product.description: With 90º or 135º options for your guttering requirements, this external angle features a moulded profile that renders it ideal for the GX moulded collection of aluminium guttering systems from Alumasc. This moulded external angle is a terrific and efficient way of directing guttering around the corners of builds, either modern or more traditional, and creating an unbroken path that accommodates rainwater flow even with shifts in the roofline. product.description: This aluminium moulded stop end is a light, well-manufactured, and useful addition to your GX moulded guttering systems. Alumasc provides you with a reliable fitting to assist you in draining water and carrying it through the guttering. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This two part circular offset angles at 135º in order to build a connection between the running outlet and the downpipe of your Flushjoint system, in turn letting the downpipe fix flush against the wall. Made from resilient and quality aluminium, the Flushjoint downpipe collection by Alumasc can be paired and used in tandem with suitably sized items from the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage guttering ranges on recent or refurbished builds. With hidden spigot connections, fittings are designed to seamlessly attach both together and to surfaces, resulting in a neat and tidy finish. Just as the rest of the Flushjoint range, this two part offset is rigid and durable to prevent cracks and leaks. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Circular 135 Degree Two Part OffsetElaborate colour palette, all coated in BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder  UK made extruded aluminium (6063 T6 alloy) that meets British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  Various sizes available  Recyclable to reduce waste.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Downpipe
product.description: Downpipes effectively guide rainwater from the guttering and down to a ground level drain, therefore expelling the water in a precise and constant path – this high-quality square downpipe from Alumasc’s Flushjoint range is certainly no exception. Crafted from exceptional extruded aluminium (from grade 6063 T6 alloy), this Flushjoint square downpipe is immensely durable, greatly lightweight, and very simple to install in contemporary applications where buildings are new or being refurbished. Alumasc made their Flushjoint downpipe collection versatile in that it can be used alongside Alumasc’s other aluminium ranges where the sizing of pipes is suitable, such as the Aqualine, GX, and Heritage ranges, and offers just as many benefits – including recyclability, smooth connections, and modern aesthetics. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 135 Degree Fixed Offset
product.description: With just one part, this 135° fixed offset is one of the multiple products in the Flush joint range from Alumasc. The squared profile works perfectly with other squared profile downpipe systems, connecting them together with smooth hidden spigots.Flushjoint systems attach at the gutter running outlet and connect down towards the downpipe. This offset plays an important part in providing this connection – allowing a 135° angle to keep the downpipes firmly fixed on the wall with appropriate brackets, as well as forming a continuous path for rainfall to find the drainage system. As one of Alumasc’s ranges, Flushjoint is constructed from non-corrosive and long-lasting extruded aluminium suitable for contemporary buildings and modern aesthetics. Although in the Flushjoint range, this square offset can be placed in Heritage, GX, and Aqualine gutters so long as the products are compatible. Whether they be on industrial uses or in rural neighbourhoods, the life expectancy of this pipe shoe – and the wider variety of Flushpipe accessories – can last upwards of 25 and 40 years, in turn providing you with an incredibly durable and highly sufficient aluminium fitting that won’t disappoint. Available in an impressive, high-quality, and BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved colour variety, this pipe shoe features factory-finished polyester powder coatings that can be matched to your guttering system for adequate colour schemes that suit a whole array of modern applications. Whether they be on industrial uses or in rural neighbourhoods, the life expectancy of this pipe shoe – and the wider variety of Flushpipe accessories – can last upwards of 25 and 40 years, in turn providing you with an incredibly durable and highly sufficient aluminium fitting that won’t disappoint. Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe ShoeFunctional in an array of Alumasc aluminium guttering systems  Holds up against rusting and makes maintenance incredibly simple  Neat attachments  Square profile from Flushjoint range  Adaptable and versatile across installations  UK made aluminium extrusions from grade 6063 T6 aluminium alloy  Complies to high British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 755)  100% recyclable at the end of use.

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 92.5 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This square profile two part offset is an immensely useful product designed to connect your running outlet to your downpipe and restore it to the wall where it can be fixed accordingly.The offset accommodates a 92.5° angle and involves concealed spigots that create seamless attachments between parts. Aluminium guttering by Alumasc is excellent in quality, easy to set up, and 100% recyclable at the end of its long-term use. Being that it is a member of the Flushjoint range of Alumasc guttering, this offset can be just as useful in a GX, Heritage, or Aqualine guttering system on up-to-date builds with contemporary layouts, as long as the paired items are completely compatible with the offset. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe Bend
product.description: Available in 92.5º, 112.5º, and 135º angles, this square profile pipe bend is a part of the innovative Flushjoint downpipe range from Alumasc. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe BendAdvantageous in colour selection  BBA (British Board of Agrément) authorised polyester powder finishes  Sturdy and strong to defend against impact, corrosion, and rusting  Requires minimal upkeep and lasts exceptionally well to make for a cost-effective option  Can be recycled and repurposed  Easy and almost undetectable mounting  Compatible with GX, Aqualine, and Heritage ranges  UK manufactured aluminium extrusions that cater to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755).

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square 92.5 Degree Two Part Offset
product.description: This square profile two part offset is an immensely useful product designed to connect your running outlet to your downpipe and restore it to the wall where it can be fixed accordingly.The offset accommodates a 92.5° angle and involves concealed spigots that create seamless attachments between parts. Aluminium guttering by Alumasc is excellent in quality, easy to set up, and 100% recyclable at the end of its long-term use. Being that it is a member of the Flushjoint range of Alumasc guttering, this offset can be just as useful in a GX, Heritage, or Aqualine guttering system on up-to-date builds with contemporary layouts, as long as the paired items are completely compatible with the offset. product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe Bend
product.description: Available in 92.5º, 112.5º, and 135º angles, this square profile pipe bend is a part of the innovative Flushjoint downpipe range from Alumasc. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs. It connects the guttering along the roofline on the fascia boards to the downpipes that scale the wall and lead to the drain. Depending on the angle and the type of application, this pipe bend can be used alone or with another pipe bend to achieve a swan neck shape. Attachments are made easy and provide a clean finish with the concealed spigots, therefore making this pipe bend, and the rest of the Flushjoint range, ideal for contemporary buildings (likewise for refurbished builds with updated aesthetics) that require sleek and smooth piping to match modernity in refined designs.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Pipe BendAdvantageous in colour selection  BBA (British Board of Agrément) authorised polyester powder finishes  Sturdy and strong to defend against impact, corrosion, and rusting  Requires minimal upkeep and lasts exceptionally well to make for a cost-effective option  Can be recycled and repurposed  Easy and almost undetectable mounting  Compatible with GX, Aqualine, and Heritage ranges  UK manufactured aluminium extrusions that cater to British standards (BS EN 12020:2001, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995 and BS EN 755).

product.name: Alumasc Flushjoint Square Small Base Clips
product.description: On buildings that have small industrial assets or fixtures that could potentially impede the constant path in your downpipe system, these square small base clips work efficiently to fix pipes to the chosen surface while simultaneously avoiding these obstacles.  For slightly projected installations that are impeccably secure, Alumasc’s Flushjoint downpipe system features small base clips made out of robust and durable aluminium. Gutter pipes and fixings are unlikely to move once mounted with these clips in place – they are non-corrodible and impact-resistant, while also being recyclable, versatile, stylish, and sleek. Flushjoint square small clips prove to be well-performing in both practical use and aesthetic design for new or refurbished builds that partake in a more contemporary trend. product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle 3m Gutter Assembly
product.description: Manufactured as part of the pressed aluminium GX Joggle gutter system range, this 3-meter gutter assembly provides you with a gutter run, designed to collect rainwater from the bottom of the roof and channel it away into the downpipe and to the rainwater system below. Light and easy to handle and install, this straightforward gutter assembly can be fixed with a simple, well-proven method with bolted and wet-sealed joints with a simple screw fixing and bracketry that can be hidden after installation to create a streamlined finish.Available in your choice of a wide variety of colours with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings and a range of gutter diameters to match your gutter system needs. Fully engineered and designed for traditional on-site wet jointing, this gutter assembly is perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. Made with vertical sides, sharp-angled bends and a returned lip, this gutter assembly is supported by top straps to increase rigidity and strength for your GX Joggle gutter system. Suitable for modern or traditional buildings, this adaptable gutter assembly can provide an all-aluminium eaves/ soffit solution and is fully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle 3m Gutter AssemblyCompatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Made in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a variety of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Made from durable, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance requirements  Made from environmentally friendly, 100% recyclable aluminium  Lightweight and easy to install with a well-proven and straightforward installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthYou can choose to expose or conceal your gutters, whichever suits your building. Made with robust and non-corrodible aluminium, this gutter assembly can fully accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint, reducing the risk of heat damage through splitting or cracking while aluminium has a life expectancy of 40 years (suburban/rural areas) and up to 25 years (marine/industrial areas) with minimal maintenance requirements.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Top Strap
product.description:
This top strap provides the essential support needed for the GX Joggle pressed aluminium gutter system range to increase strength and rigidity. Available in a range of colours and sizes, this top strap is designed to match your gutter system. This lightweight top strap is easy to install and is part of a straightforward gutter assembly installation.
Manufactured with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings, this top strap has been fully engineered and designed for traditional on-site wet jointing. Ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required for large amounts of rainfall and designed with sharp-angled bends and vertical sides, this top strap is part of a gutter system with a returned lip on the gutters. These gutters can simply be fixed with a well-proven method with wet-sealed and bolted joints with a screw bracketry and fixing that can be hidden to create a streamlined finish. This top strap is ideal for traditional or modern buildings.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Top StrapFully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system  Manufactured in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a range of colours to match your gutter system with factory-applied BBA approved polyester powder coatings   Available in a range of gutter diameter sizes  Made from robust, non-corrodible aluminium with minimal maintenance required and a long life expectancy  Easy to install with a straightforward, well-proven installation method  Made from lightweight, recyclable aluminium and environmentally friendly  Provides full support for increased rigidity and strengthThis adaptable top strap can help provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution and is completely compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/soffit system. With your choice of concealed or exposed gutters, this top strap requires minimal maintenance once installed. This durable, non-corrosive top strap is made from aluminium with a life expectancy of 40 years in suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years in marine/industrial areas. This GX Joggle gutter system is designed to reduce the risk of heat damage through splitting or cracking by fully accommodating thermal movement at every secure joint.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Standard Running Outlet
product.description:
This standard running outlet has been manufactured from aluminium and is part of the GX aluminium gutter range from Alumasc. Alumasc have been manufacturing high quality guttering and rainwater systems for years, and use new technologies and innovative manufacturing processes to create products that not only meet industry standards, but also surpass expectations in terms of performance, durability and design.
This standard running outlet has been designed specifically for use with GX guttering products with the joggle profile. The joggle range of GX guttering comprises of vertical sides, sharp angled bends, and a returned lip, and has been designed for use in areas of high rainfall as it copes with large volumes of water with no issues.
The running outlet provides a connection between a gutter run and a downpipe, in order to transport the rainwater from the roof and into the drainage system. The running outlet is most commonly connected to a gutter run towards the side of a house, and is often paired with a stop end to ensure water gets directed into the downpipe.
Why choose Alumasc GX guttering?
Performance
The Alumasc GX gutter range has been designed specifically as a high capacity gutter that can be used on both traditional and modern buildings. The Alumasc GX range is available in three different profiles, but each profile has been designed in a way that delivers maximum capacity and flow rate.
The GX Alumasc range of guttering is designed to fully accommodate thermal movement at every joint, and is lightweight, durable and highly corrosion resistant.
Installation
The GX aluminium guttering range has been designed for traditional wet jointing on site. This involves the simple and well proven method of screw fixing with bracketry, which is generally concealed after installation to create a sleek and uniform finish.
The GX Joggle range is supported by top straps, whilst the GX Smooth range has been designed to not require any visible screw fixing or support brackets to create a smooth finish, whilst the GX Moulded range is wet jointed, fixed directly to the building fabric.
Environmentally friendly
The GX guttering range is a compact and efficient rainwater system that is manufactured from 100% recyclable aluminium in the UK. Additionally, the GX guttering system has a life expectancy of 40 years or more in rural or suburban areas, and up to 25 years in industrial and marine environments. This means that not only are less gutter profiles required over time due to their long lasting design, when they are finally replaced they can be recycled.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Union Clip
product.description:
Designed to join two sections of gutter together while fixed to the fascia board to support the joint, this union clip provides support for the GX Joggle range of pressed aluminium gutter systems. Lightweight and easy to install with a simple, well-proven method, this union clip is part of the GX Joggle installation that can be fixed with wet-sealed and bolted joints with a straightforward screw fixing with bracketry that can be concealed after installation.
Available in a variety of colours with factory-applied BBA certified polyester powder coatings and a range of diameters to match your GX Joggle gutter system. This fully engineered union clip, designed for traditional wet jointing on-site, is ideal for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. This Joggle union clip has been designed with sharp-angled bends and vertical sides with the GX Joggle range made with a returned lip and a supportive top strap for increased strength and rigidity. Adaptable to modern or traditional buildings this union clip is part of the GX Joggle range that can provide a soffit solution/ all-aluminium eaves with your choice of exposed or concealed gutters.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Union ClipFully compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Manufactured in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a range of colours with BBA certified polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters  Made from robust, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance required after installation  Made from environmentally friendly, recyclable aluminium  Light and easy to install with a well-proven and straightforward installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthManufactured with durable and non-corrodible aluminium, this union clip has a life expectancy of 40 years for suburban/rural areas and up to 25 years for marine/industrial areas with minimal maintenance required once installed. The GX Joggles gutters are made to fully accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint, reducing the risk of damage through cracking or splitting.

This GX Joggle stop-end is compatible with the GX Joggle range of pressed aluminium gutter systems.This full-engineered and durable stop-end has been designed for traditional wet jointing on-site and is perfect for applications where maximum capacity gutters are required. Made with sharp-angled bends, a returned lip and vertical sides, this box section stop-end is supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strength. Suitable for modern or traditional buildings, this versatile stop-end can provide an all-aluminium eaves/soffit solution with your choice of concealed or exposed gutters. This stop-end is available in a range of colours, factory finished with BBA certified polyester powder coatings and comes in a range of sizes with left or right-handed ends to tailor to your installation needs.Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Stop-EndCompletely compatible with Alumasc’s Skyline fascia/ soffit system  Made in the UK  Pressed from sheet aluminium to British Standards  Available in a wide variety of colours with BBA approved polyester powder coatings  Available in a range of gutter diameters and left or right-handed  Made from robust, non-corrosive aluminium with a long life expectancy and minimal maintenance needed  Made from 100% recyclable aluminium  Easy to handle and fix with a well-proven and simple installation method  Supported by top straps for increased rigidity and strengthThis lightweight stop-end is easy to install with a well-proven, straightforward method of bolted and wet-sealed joints with a simple screw fixing with bracketry which can be concealed after installation. Made from robust and non-corrosive aluminium, this stop-end has a life expectancy of 40 years for rural/suburban areas and up to 25 years for industrial/ marine areas with minimal maintenance required once installed. This stop-end is designed to wholly accommodate thermal movement at every secure joint.

product.name: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal Angle
product.description:
For gutter installations that require sharp turns of a corner or that need to avoid any potential interruptions for a straight path, this joggle internal angle is a fantastic product to connect to a joggle gutter run and therefore ensure water can flow from the gutter to the downpipe. 
This internal angle features a joggle profile as part of Alumasc’s GX joggle range, which makes it ideal to fit in with the joggle system as it shares a distinct design that accommodates heavy rainfall and utilises innovative technology, therefore allowing for thermal movement. GX gutters are suitable for high capacity flow and work fantastically on both traditional and contemporary builds. Joggle installations can be extremely discreet with easy bracketry and top straps, and this internal angle follows in line by subtly connecting to the guttering run.  Features & Benefits: Alumasc GX Joggle Internal AngleSize options to suit different gutters  Resistant to corrosion and rusting  Unlikely to break or leak  Recyclable  BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved  Perfect for longevity installations with a 25-40 year lifespan  Made from British standard aluminium (BS EN 1462:1997, BS EN 612:1996, BS EN 515:1993, BS EN 573:1995, BS EN 485).
product.variant_name: Alumasc GX Joggle 90dg Internal Angle in Black - 100mm x 75mm

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Downpipe
product.description:
This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. The range includes a versatile as-sortment of fitting methods, including wall fixings, brackets, and pipe clips.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular DownpipeColour assortment  UK made  Non-heavy but durable  Recyclable extruded aluminium  Created in line with BBA (British Board of Agrément) and quality British standards (BS 8530)  Multiple sizes and lengths to choose from. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.

This aluminium rounded downpipe by Alumasc is ideal for providing water with an unobstructed and direct path down to the drainage system. Attaching this downpipe to the rest of the Heritage range of guttering is achieved with cast sockets.
As a product from the Heritage collection by Alumasc, this downpipe holds many benefits and advantages – compatible with many eave installations on builds with a more traditional aesthetic, even newer ones, Heritage pipes are unlikely to corrode due to the durable aluminium structures and therefore make any required maintenance simple and fast. The range includes a versatile as-sortment of fitting methods, including wall fixings, brackets, and pipe clips.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular DownpipeColour assortment  UK made  Non-heavy but durable  Recyclable extruded aluminium  Created in line with BBA (British Board of Agrément) and quality British standards (BS 8530)  Multiple sizes and lengths to choose from. Like its fellow Heritage guttering items, this circular downpipe is an aluminium extrusion that can have a BBA (British Board of Agrément) approved polyester powder finish that bears a resemblance to cast iron. In turn, this system is an ideal substitute for real cast iron fittings.

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Stop End
product.description:
Part of Alumasc's durable and long-lasting 'Heritage' range, these Victorian ogee stop ends combine period style with modern materials. Designed specifically as a direct replacement for older cast iron fittings, these stop ends boast an impressive service life of up to forty years in rural or suburban areas. Combining longevity and versatility, the Heritage system is ready for your next retrofit or ground-up guttering project with an extensive range of fixture options and minimal maintenance.
This gutter system is lightweight, durable, and highly resistant to corrosion, having earned British Standards (BS) and British Board of Agrément (BBA) approval. In addition, these sections come in a range of imperial measurements as well as a variety of popular profiles, with the system serving as an excellent substitute for that characteristic cast-iron texture.Features & Benefits: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Victorian Ogee Stop EndHard-wearing coated aluminium means these gutters can last up to forty years in suburban and rural areasMeets with British Standards and British Board of Agrément specificationsDesigned specifically for replacing older cast-iron fixturesSuitable for both flush and projecting eave applications

product.name: Alumasc Heritage Aluminium Circular Pipe Bend
product.description:
A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements
product.variant_name: Aluminium Guttering Round Downpipe 92.5dg Bend 63mm - Black

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes

Easy to handle and fix

Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Minimal maintenance requirements

A range of traditionally designed, socketed aluminium downpipes. Connections between pipes and fittings are made with loose cast sockets, available with ears for fixing back to the wall. Pipes can also be fixed with a choice of base clips to give alternative projections.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Heritage downpipes are extruded sections with cast sockets
Compatible with all Alumasc aluminium gutter systems
Factory finished, in a choice of 1, 2 and 3 metre pipe lengths

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance

UK manufactured, extruded aluminium
Choice of circular, square and rectangular pipes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Pipe jointing by separate sockets gives maximum flexibility for installation
Simple fixing to wall by eared sockets or by a choice of pipe clips
Minimal maintenance requirements

These Alumasc 'Heritage' beaded deep-run gutters are the starting point for a reliable and robust range of guttering sections and fittings. An ideal pairing for traditional buildings that need every ounce of character preserved, these gutter sections are perfect for replacing older, heavier cast-iron fixtures or lending style to all sorts of contemporary builds. 
The 'Heritage' range uses durable coated aluminium to produce longevity, quality, and versatility for the best results in both flush and projecting eave applications. A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

A full range of traditional gutter profiles with simple spigot joints, wet sealed and bolted with an extensive range of fixing options. Heritage aluminium gutters are manufactured using modern aluminium casting techniques and are factory finished.Applications

Ideal for traditionally designed buildings
Used as a direct replacement of cast iron
Also appropriate for modern, fast track contracts
For both flush and projecting eaves applications

Colours & Finishes

BBA approved polyester powder coatings
In-house powder coating facility
16 standard factory applied colours
BS or RAL colours available to special order
Can be supplied to resemble cast iron surface texture (black) to special order
Also available in plain mill finish for on-site painting

Performance 

BBA approved
UK manufactured in accordance with BS 2997:1958 (1980)
5 profiles available in a choice of imperial sizes
Lightweight, durable and non-corrodible
Easy to handle and fix
Life expectancy of aluminium: 40 years (rural/suburban areas); up to 25 years (industrial/marine areas)
Aluminium is 100% recyclable

Installation & Fixing

Wet sealed and bolted joints
Extensive range of fixing options
Minimal maintenance requirements

product.name: ACO MultiDrain M100D Vienite D400 Channel Drain - 1000mm
product.description: This ACO MultiDrain™ M100D Channel Drain is made from secure, sturdy Vienite®, which is ACO's high-strength material. Resistant to chemicals and highly sustainable, this channel is designed to last with integral galvanised steel protective edge rails manufactured from UltraSTEEL™ for enhanced durability and strength compared to plain steel.Due to UltraSTEEL™ having a larger surface area, it elevates the bond between the rail and the adjacent material where a sealed system is necessary. M100D channels are also available in constant depth, sloping depth and shallow depth units. product.name: ACO Threshold A15 Plastic Channel Drain - 1000mm
product.description:
ACO Threshold channel drain is designed for use in domestic properties to eliminate any water from pooling at external doors. The threshold is only 60mm wide and sits flush to the door for maximum discretion, allowing water to be drained away quickly and efficiently. Whilst ACO Threshold channel drain has been built with long-life and durability in mind, a choice of built-in silver or black Heelguard grates offer aesthetic design too.
This ACO Threshold channel drain comes with an attached black aluminium grate with Heelguard design. Heelguard design means that high heels can't become lodged in the grate as the slits are too narrow, reducing the risk of injury to people entering and exiting the property or damage to the channel drain grate. The extruded plastic base of ACO Threshold channel drain only bolsters the security of the drain once the system has been bedded in concrete.
ACO Threshold channel drain can be connected, thanks to 80mm diameter outlets, to domestic soakaways and accessories like a drain connector, 80mm bottom outlet and closing end cap complete the drain system.

product.name: ACO C-Line Shower & Wet Room Channel Drain Grating
product.description:
The ShowerDrain C series is characterised by modern design and perfect functionality. The basic is the high quality stainless steel which is used for the production of the shower channel itself, gully and grating. The foul air trap is made out of polypropylene. The steel parts are passivated; the gratings are brushed to the silk gloss. From the user's point of view the ACO ShowerDrain C excelled especially by the high flow rate, very low construction height and very easy maintenance.

50mm Outlet
High Flow Rate 0.9l/s
Channel Supplied with Grating

Low Construction Height
The standard model of ACO ShowerDrain C 50 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has a construction height only 92 mm. The lowered model (30 mm of water column in the foul air trap) has incredible construction height of only 65 mm. If integrated foul air trap not needed, it is possible to install ACO ShowerDrain C only with the spigot. In this case, the construction height is equal to the height of the channel only 18 mm. These values enable very wide application of ACO ShowerDrain C in the modern new buildings and buildings under reconstruction.Easy maintenance
The user´s comfort is increased by the efficiency of the foul air trap and its easy cleaning. Syphon (foul air trap) is made out of plastics. The reliable seal is injection-moulded together with the foul air trap. Due to this construction, there is no risk of losing of the sealing, or another malfunction. The foul air trap can be easily removed from the shower channel. It is easy to disassemble it into two separate parts and clean it by hand or in a dish washer.

product.name: ACO Rainwater Roof Overflow Outlet with Dome Grate
product.description: Manufactured from Aluminium and part of ACO's Building Drainage HP (high performance) range, this Rainwater Roof Overflow Outlet with a Dome Grate is ideal for roofing at risk of pooling water. Complete with a dome grate that helps stop leaves and other debris from falling into the system and causing a blockage on the roof area. Without a suitable outlet, unwanted excess water can begin to spill over the sides of the building, weighing down the roof structure by a significant amount. Ideal for circular 50mm or 75mm pipe diameter rainwater outlets, this overflow unit will keep unplanned excess water from affecting the roof for many years. Overflow units are also supplied with a PVC tube 250mm long. These can be easily cut on-site, ensuring the maximum permissible overflow height matches the requirements for the fitting. product.description: With a 142mm outlet and a range of dimensions available, this ACO HygieneFirst 304 Stainless Steel Kitchen Tray Vinyl Edge Channel Drain is part of ACO’s HygieneFirst drainage system. The system works to prevent the dangerous bacteria and pathogen food contamination that can often arise from drainage elements. Ideal for vinyl floors, this Kitchen Tray Vinyl Edge Channel Drain boasts a structure of 304-grade stainless steel and comes equipped with concrete fixing anchors and 60mm to 110mm adjustable levelling feet. product.name: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Access Frame Extension
product.description:
ACO FreeDeck is an advanced roof and balcony drainage system combining line drainage with point drainage by using an open sided drainage channel system to collect and convey rainwater to drainage points within a raised or suspended deck structure.Rainwater is intercepted at 3 points:

Surface run-off
Percolation within the deck
Rainwater outlet positions

Manufactured in galvanised steel or stainless steel, ACO FreeDeck channel is simply laid directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. Efficient drainage is provided where paving's are required to be laid 'open or closed joint' improving safety for foot traffic and weathered protection of the building fabric.
Complying with national access regulations, ACO FreeDeck channels provide level access drainage in compliance with:

England and Wales Building Regulations ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDING: Approved Document M
Scottish Building Standards DOMESTIC AND NON DOMESTIC HANDBOOK: Section 4
Northern Ireland Building Regulations, DFP Technical Booklet R: 2006 ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDINGS: Section 7

Key Features
ACO FreeDeck is used for rainwater drainage and safe access in a variety of applications

Drainage for all types of suspended deck construction
A system that details into all types of flat roof finishes
Practical within all applications throughout building life
A drainage system that protects and maintains the building fabric

product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.
ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.

Easy installation
